name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 19 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 19 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
